name: How should I prepare my kitchen before cabinet removal begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my kitchen before cabinet removal begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners must clear all items from the cabinets, pantries, and countertops before the crew arrives. Ensure pathways through the home to the exit are clear for carrying bulky boxes. You should also decide ahead of time whether you want the cabinets salvaged for resale, donation, or garage storage, or completely hauled away for disposal. Disconnecting water, gas, or cooktop wiring connected to base cabinets must also be coordinated prior to unfastening.
acceptedAnswer.description: Empty all cabinets and countertops, clear wide walking paths to exterior doors, and decide beforehand whether you are salvaging or disposing of the old units.
